**4h**

I started from the very basics and chose to make the Starbie project. I had some prior electronic experince but  I didn't know how to use kid cad or and CAD software at all. I watched tons of diffrent project and youtube videos how to to get started. It was super helpful and I learend alot about Schenmatic designs and how these programs operate.
